additionalInputLocation.csharp: ValidateGenericSpecialization -> ValidateSpecializedInputOwnership uses BoundAdditionalParameter.Line/Column, the parameter name (1:25 in the frozen case).
additionalInputLocation.slg: appendInvalidMoveInputSignature uses parameter AST start; kind60 includes the preceding comma (1:23). AST lowering stores the parameter name in payloadToken.
additionalInputLocation.decision: Capture additional input name-token span; retain function-declaration span for primary input. Do not shift columns by a constant or change the oracle.

callbackAliasName.csharp: EmitYield binds frame.ItemName in caller callback scope, with the yielded value type and ownership. Caller name identity and callee value identity are separate.
callbackAliasName.slg: materializeBlockCallback copies the yielded input, then changes symbol/sourceModule/astNode to the caller role but leaves payloadToken in the producer token namespace. mutableBindingNameBucket indexes that payload in the caller range.
callbackAliasName.decision: Publish callerRole.nameToken with the caller alias symbol/sourceModule/astNode; preserve the yielded value type and transfer edge. Do not suppress ownership indexing or add an invalid-token fallback.
